title: Ostinato: Low-Latency CPU-GPU MoE Inference for Local Agents
abstract: arXiv:2611.11533v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Language-model agents increasingly run on local workstations with consumer GPUs, where quantized mixture-of-experts (MoE) models split routed experts between GPU and host memory. Prefix-cached agent sessions alternate single-token decode with short tool-return prefills, typically up to a few hundred tokens. Short tool turns touch more experts than consumer GPUs can hold, yet direct roughly 85% of DeepSeek-V4-Flash's routes to a static GPU pool while leaving 3.3-5.5 tokens per cold expert. Widely used local engines such as llama.cpp and KTransformers either copy tens of gigabytes over PCIe per turn, compute every route on the CPU while idling resident GPU experts, or budget GPU memory by whole layers and uniform per-layer quotas. We present Ostinato, a CPU-GPU MoE engine that reuses one static cross-layer GPU pool in place across every forward pass. During decode and short tool turns, Ostinato computes resident routes on the GPU

translated_title: Ostinato：面向本地智能体的低延迟CPU-GPU混合专家模型推理
translated_abstract: 语言模型智能体越来越多地运行在配备消费级GPU的本地工作站上，其中量化的混合专家（MoE）模型将路由专家分配在GPU与主机内存之间。带有前缀缓存的智能体会话在单token解码与简短的工具返回预填充之间交替进行，通常最多几百个token。简短的工具调用轮次所触及的专家数量超出了消费级GPU的容纳能力，然而却有约85%的DeepSeek-V4-Flash路由被引导至一个静态GPU池，同时每个冷专家平均只承载3.3-5.5个token。广泛使用的本地引擎（如llama.cpp和KTransformers）要么每轮通过PCIe复制数十GB的数据，要么在CPU上计算所有路由而让常驻的GPU专家闲置，要么按整层和统一的每层配额来规划GPU内存。我们提出了Ostinato，一个CPU-GPU混合专家引擎，它在每次前向传播中原位复用一个静态的跨层GPU池。在解码和简短工具调用轮次期间，Ostinato在GPU上计算常驻路由
tldr: 提出Ostinato引擎，通过在每次前向传播中原位复用一个静态的跨层GPU池，实现CPU与GPU协同的混合专家模型推理，为本地智能体提供低延迟支持。
